callflow:
sequenceDiagram participant A as Phone 1001 participant P as pocket-dial participant B as Phone 1002 A->>P: INVITE sip:1002 (SDP offer) P->>B: INVITE to 1002's registered Contact,
Contact rewritten to the board,
SDP unchanged Note over P: ring timer armed,
20 s or 1002's configured no-answer time B->>P: 100 Trying, 180 Ringing P->>A: 100 Trying, 180 Ringing (relayed) B->>P: 200 OK (SDP answer) P->>A: 200 OK, SDP unchanged,
Contact rewritten A->>P: ACK P->>B: ACK A-->>B: RTP, peer to peer B-->>A: RTP, peer to peer A->>P: BYE P->>A: 200 OK
(the board answers it itself) P->>B: BYE (the board's own request,
its own Via and CSeq) B->>P: 200 OK, the call ends
callfail:
sequenceDiagram participant A as Phone 1001 participant P as pocket-dial participant B as Phone 1002 A->>P: INVITE sip:1002 alt the offer has no PCMU, PCMA or G.722 P->>A: 488 Not Acceptable Here else 1002 has Do Not Disturb on P->>A: 480 Temporarily Unavailable else 1002 is not registered P->>A: 404 Not Found else no free call slot P->>A: 503 Service Unavailable else 1002 rings P->>B: INVITE B->>P: 180 Ringing P->>A: 180 Ringing alt the caller hangs up first A->>P: CANCEL P->>A: 200 OK P->>B: CANCEL B->>P: 487 Request Terminated P->>A: 487 Request Terminated
(the board sends its own after 32 s
if 1002 never does) A->>P: ACK P->>B: ACK else nobody answers within the ring time P->>B: CANCEL P->>A: 480 Temporarily Unavailable,
unless 1002 forwards on no answer
or has voicemail end end
emergency:
sequenceDiagram participant H as Phone participant P as pocket-dial participant X as 3CX anchor participant N as E911 notify list H->>P: INVITE 911 (or 933,
9911, 9933) from a
registered phone Note over P: logged EMERGENCY first,
ahead of every
operator setting Note over P: an offer with none of
PCMU, PCMA or G.722
never gets this far:
a plain 488 at the codec gate alt the 3CX anchor is the provider and accepts the job P->>X: makeCall 911,
the bare number,
on the tel_sos worker P->>H: 180 Ringing P->>N: notification, routed alt the far leg answers X-->>P: Answered P->>H: 200 OK, PCMU,
the board bridges
the audio else 3CX drops the leg before it connects X-->>P: Dropped P->>H: 503 Service Unavailable P->>N: correction, NOT ROUTED end else no real anchor, not connected, no free slot,
or the offer has PCMA or G.722 but no PCMU P->>H: 503 Emergency Call
Not Routable,
Warning says why,
no Retry-After
(for that offer, if the
anchor is connected:
no G.711 codec offered) P->>N: notification, NOT ROUTED
and the reason end Note over P: never a SIP trunk,
never a 404,
never reaped for RTP silence
learn:
stateDiagram-v2
    direction TB
    state "Learned" as Learned {
        state "Learned, unlocked" as U
        state "Learned, locked" as K
        U --> K: 2 re-register
        U --> U: 3 second ext.
        K --> K: 4 other MAC, 403
    }
    state "Secured" as SEC
    [*] --> U: 1 first REGISTER
    Learned --> SEC: 5 admin secures it
    SEC --> SEC: 6 digest, 401
    Learned --> [*]
    SEC --> [*]: 7 admin forgets it
    classDef st fill:#e3edf4,stroke:#3f6f8c
    classDef lk fill:#ececec,stroke:#5d6c78
    classDef sc fill:#e4f1e6,stroke:#3a7d44
    class U st
    class K lk
    class SEC sc
